explanation: Maintain indices of decreasing candidate volumes in a deque. Remove expired timestamps from the front and no-better candidates from the back before adding each sample. The front supplies the maximum for the inclusive time window.
spaceComplexity: O(w) candidate space for at most w active samples, plus output.
attribution: Original C++ implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from the displayed problem contract and repository-authored C# algorithms. Uses the existing local native test-framework API. No upstream reference implementation was altered or translated.
